title.en: Cambridge Springs Defense: the Bd3 trap

stageReason: Needs 1...d5 as Black; eight setup moves.

idea.ru: Пешка бьёт на c4 с нападением на слона d3 и открывает ферзя на слона g5.
idea.en: The pawn takes on c4, attacking the d3-bishop and uncovering the queen against the g5-bishop.
